name: matrixaddons/document-engine
description: Document library, PDF viewer and post to PDF for WordPress

scripts.prune-mpdf: @php -r '$r="vendor/mpdf/mpdf"; $b=chr(92); $q=chr(39); foreach (glob("$r/ttfonts/*") as $f) { if (!preg_match("/^(DejaVu|fontawesome-webfont)/", basename($f))) { unlink($f); } } foreach (["phpstan-baseline.neon","phpunit.xml",".github","utils","CHANGELOG.md","CREDITS.txt","README.md","SECURITY.md"] as $j) { exec("rm -rf " . escapeshellarg("$r/$j")); } foreach (["src/Tag.php","src/Tag/Tag.php"] as $t) { $c = file_get_contents("$r/$t"); file_put_contents("$r/$t", str_replace("{$q}Mpdf{$b}Tag{$b}{$b}{$q}", "{$q}MatrixAddons{$b}DocumentEngine{$b}Vendor{$b}Mpdf{$b}Tag{$b}{$b}{$q}", $c)); }'
